design: post-A1 selected DEV checkpoint diagnosis; four fixtures x two APIs; same observation, not fresh end-to-end evaluation

generation.KV: BF16 within request ON; across-turn prefix cache OFF

execution_boundary: same saved INT4 -> dense BF16; D16 FP32 input*beta_inverse -> BF16; BF16 W_pre; no new quantization

C0.malformed_only: stop; correct diagnostic label PARSE_ERROR, historical stale BUDGET_EXHAUSTED remains untouched

G.grammar: actual allowed-token mask on first checkpoint response only
G.source: four declared tool contracts plus free final-answer field types
G.complete_call_JSON_EOS_without_closing_m: allowed to preserve original parser acceptance

N.trigger: new same-method C0 has >=1 attempted marker slot and zero accepted parsed dicts; no mixed retry; remaining model/tool/time budget
N.feedback: No tool was executed. Retry the previous response.
N.assistant_content: the same newly observed C0 raw_text; never a historical substitute

E.trigger: exact same new C0 as N
E.feedback: PARSE_ERROR: Tool-call JSON could not be parsed. No tool was executed. Retry the previous response.

retry_observations: host feedback is user content; no fake tool result; available_result_event_ids and file state unchanged
same_input_policy: G/C0 payload and token hashes equal; N/E full prompts differ; track shared observation/state separately from intervention/full request hashes

budget.prefix_elapsed_debit: common conservative maximum original full episode wall among methods, an upper bound, not an exact prefix measurement
budget.branch_elapsed_includes: prefix debit + shared actual C0 wall + host/intervention overhead + branch continuation wall/idle
budget.future_worker_budget_gate: requires separate approval; no GPU execution in this registration

call_plan.F_definition: new malformed-only C0 branches eligible for one retry after cumulative model/tool/time budget checks; count total malformed and ineligible separately
call_plan.N_E_first: 2*F, using one shared C0 response per method/checkpoint
call_plan.reason: C0 malformed-only branches stop; valid C0/G each have <=5 further calls; each N/E has <=4 calls after its retry; prefix requests are charged but not regenerated

endpoint.requires: actual correct write, immutable/other records preserved throughout, validation for current state observed before final, strict final fields/types, original read/multiply receipt order
endpoint.no_new_scores: all recovery cells NOT_RUN; scripted tests are synthetic_contract_test

interpretation.G_full_recovery: supports a serialization bottleneck on these selected DEV checkpoints
interpretation.E_vs_N: needed to isolate the error-description contribution
interpretation.C0_mismatch: hold causal interpretation; separate environment/execution/output-token mismatch first
interpretation.generalization: not held-out or a general quantization claim

future_gates: explicit GPU approval and total worker budget
full local model/tokenizer/config identity; actual module coverage 252 per RTN/D16
saved artifact hashes/bytes, read-only loader beta_inverse/W_pre and unchanged small weights
24 recorded C0 input hashes after retokenization (8 unique payloads)
new C0 output_token_ids reproduce all24 historical references; otherwise hold mechanism claims
real model/processor integration: FiniteBudget before mask; G only first response; stop tokens and request budgets
full primary endpoint replay/auditor for new records

registered_runtime_flags.note: historically recorded flags; actual future runtime must match, not rerun in CPU preparation
